newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Burns Philp falls further 10 cents.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Burns Philp falls further 10 cents.

text.p: Global food group Burns Philp & Co Ltd shed a further 10 cents in early trade on Friday after easing five cents on Thursday following the release of its half year results.
The yeast and spice manufacturer was at $1.95, with 426,134 shares traded by 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT).
"There's been a couple of negative articles in the press," said a senior Sydney-based broker. "As far as we can see it's just a reaction to that."

Burns Philp reported a net trading profit of A$51 million for the six months to December 31, up from A$50 million previously, and said the full year trading result was not expected to differ significantly from 1995/96.
Several analysts said they would revise down their full year forecasts for the group following the announcement.
